A poem for Termaka

32.

Young as rain. You fly to the skies, you stay in your lane. You hope for a day in which you will be flying high. And one day be free.

From working and living in sadness like doves you hope and you pray to fly high above and conquer the world as one day you see fit You fly to the heavens And you do so with wit.

✦

You pray to Heavenly Father and ask for his grace and hopes that one day your life will just trace and be something more than you ever could have known as you fly through the heavens like the Bible has shown.

You're a beautiful star and you try to be great I admire your life and let's enjoy this date

✦

Another poem for Termaka

Poem Two

As I sit here and watch the flame. My heart is full of warmth. Pray and wonder each day. How to make your brain display a comical bright on this gloomy day.

The sun is shining and the day is young. Our lives are twinkling through the lifely drum of hoping and wondering what will come next.

✦

We lay here under the moon and the stars and are blessed.

✦
